derivation: from G5104 (τοί) and G1063 (γάρ) and G3767 (οὖν);

occurrences.text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
